question:
In a code language, ‘RACE’ is written as ‘VWGA’, and ‘BANK’ is written as ‘FWRG’.

How will ‘STEM’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

**RACE: VWGA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3c6fb06499ba55a14b33048371e932b22f3473f498999c4db4825f120821cf3.png] 

**BANK: FWRG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c22919da997e308f25430dcb29fbc74fa973134b33260c3005e3b57dd45817b3.png] 

Similarly,

**STEM: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76f070100c552d6af4828bb852aa012ea200d03c53bdbd218e61e2c759496ba.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"WPII"**.
